newsitem.title: USA: Median US home value $92,500 in 1995-Commerce Dept.
newsitem.headline: Median US home value $92,500 in 1995-Commerce Dept.

text.p: The median value of the 63.5 million owner-occupied homes in the United States in 1995 was $92,500, the government said in a report released Monday.

The Commerce Department's Census Bureau and the Department of Housing and Urban Development said values varied greatly by region -- $140,300 in the West, $118,900 in the Northeast, $80,100 in the Midwest and $76,000 in the South.
The report, American Housing Survey for the United States in 1995, also said that 65 percent of the occupied housing units were owned or being bought, and 35 percent rented.
Some 5.8 million units were constructed between 1991 and 1995, of which 2.6 million were built in the South, 1.3 million in both the West and Midwest and 600,000 in the Northeast.
